name: Question 2
problem:
Consider the following initial value problem:

$$
{y}^{′}={e}^{x}-3xy,\,y(-2)=3
$$

The trapezoidal method is applied with step size $Δx=1.$ Find the general formula for the new $y$ value, ${y}_{\text{new}},$ in terms of the current values $x$ and $y,$ and the new value ${x}_{\text{new}}.$
worked_solution:
For an initial value problem

$$
{y}^{′}=f(x,y),\,y(a)=c,
$$

the trapezoidal method with step size $Δx$ is given by

$$
Δy=\frac{1}{2}({y}^{′}+{y}_{\text{new}}^{′})\cdot Δx,
$$

with ${y}_{\text{new}}^{′}=f({x}_{\text{new}},{y}_{\text{new}})$ evaluated at the next $x$ and $y$ values.

In this example, $Δy$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & =\frac{1}{2}({y}^{′}+{y}_{\text{new}}^{′})\cdot Δx \\  & =\frac{1}{2}({e}^{x}-3xy+({e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}-3{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}}))\cdot 1 \\  & =\frac{1}{2}({e}^{x}+{e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}-3xy)-\frac{3}{2}{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}}.\end{aligned}
$$

We substitute this into ${y}_{\text{new}}=y+Δy:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}_{\text{new}} & =y+Δy \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =y+\frac{1}{2}({e}^{x}+{e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}-3xy)-\frac{3}{2}{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}} \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =\frac{1}{2}({e}^{x}+{e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}-3xy+2y)-\frac{3}{2}{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we solve for the general formula for ${y}_{\text{new}}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}_{\text{new}}+\frac{3}{2}{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}} & =\frac{1}{2}({e}^{x}+{e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}-3xy+2y) \\ \frac{1}{2}{y}_{\text{new}}(2+3{x}_{\text{new}}) & =\frac{1}{2}({e}^{x}+{e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}-3xy+2y) \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =\frac{{e}^{x}+{e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}-3xy+2y}{2+3{x}_{\text{new}}}\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the following initial value problem: y′=ex−3xy,y(−2)=3 The trapezoidal method is applied with step size Δx=1. Find the general formula for the new y value, ynew, in terms of the current values x and y, and the new value xnew.

a
ynew=ex+exnew+2y2−3xnew
b
ynew=y+exnew1+3xnew
c
ynew=ex+exnew−3xy+2y2+3xnew
d
ynew=ex+exnew−3xy+y1+3xnew
e
ynew=ex+exnew−3xy−2y2−3xnew
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

For an initial value problem y′=f(x,y),y(a)=c, the trapezoidal method with step size Δx is given by Δy=12(y′+ynew′)⋅Δx, with ynew′=f(xnew,ynew) evaluated at the next x and y values.

In this example, Δy is given by

Δy=12(y′+ynew′)⋅Δx=12(ex−3xy+(exnew−3xnewynew))⋅1=12(ex+exnew−3xy)−32xnewynew.

We substitute this into ynew=y+Δy:

ynew=y+Δyynew=y+12(ex+exnew−3xy)−32xnewynewynew=12(ex+exnew−3xy+2y)−32xnewynew

Finally, we solve for the general formula for ynew:

ynew+32xnewynew=12(ex+exnew−3xy+2y)12ynew(2+3xnew)=12(ex+exnew−3xy+2y)ynew=ex+exnew−3xy+2y2+3xnew
